statusDetail: Cloudflare bot verification intercepted the requested Discogs page. Headless Chrome remained on “Just a moment...” and direct HTTP probes returned 403 with cf-mitigated: challenge, so Discogs content and flows were unavailable.

page.notes: The origin application did not become reachable. Only Cloudflare’s bot-verification document rendered.
